title: AI-accelerator vendors lock mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence by Q4 2026
body: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.

reasoning.because: Nvidia + AMD ship same-day May 8 forward-supply 8-Ks naming GW + customer-by-customer commitments.
reasoning.given: Cerebras IPO multiple + SEC Corp Fin sample letter + Mag-7 capex-vs-revenue ROI gap pressure cohort.
reasoning.so_that: AI-accelerator vendors adopt a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as standard disclosure.
reasoning.landing: By Q4 2026; >=2 pre-announcement 8-Ks per issuer ahead of the Q3 print cycle.
reasoning.plain_language: Nvidia and AMD both filed surprise customer-update reports on the same day, so chip vendors will keep filing them between earnings.

summary: Nvidia + AMD May 8 dual 8-Ks disclose Vera Rubin nine-of-ten hyperscaler commitments and a 6.2GW Helios + MI450 book including 0.8GW Tencent Cloud. By Q4 2026 AI-accelerator vendors lock a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence as standard disclosure.
